title: DNS: make DnsTap available in public headers (fixes #21092)
description:
My attempt on making the DnsTap struct available in public headers (see #21092). I went as far as to also move and rename several preprocessor macros to make it easier to work with the data contained in DnsTap.

I'd like to kindly request that someone who is more familiar with the source code than I am has a thorough look at this. Any feedback is appreciated, thanks in advance.

AI-Assisted: no

I made some minor adjustments that were just easier to fix than comment on:
1. You shouldn't need to explicitly add packet-dns.h to the "public header" list.  The fact that it has WS_DLL_PUBLIC use will make it "public" (via scripts that look for it)
2. packet.h shouldn't need be included in a dissector header file
3. Tweaks of commit message
Forgot that you need to "manually" add the header file because the pipeline checks that you ran the script to "automatically" add it.
